description: The labelled accuracy set for identity resolution. The rate this file produces is the project's most important metric; measure it after every change that touches matching. When you find a new class of error, first add a case here and watch the test fail. The MBIDs are fixture values and cannot be used as real MusicBrainz ids.

expectations.expect_mbid (set): the resolution must be tied to exactly this recording
expectations.expect_mbid (null): it must not be tied to any authority — it must fall back to the local key
expectations.expect_method: if given, this link of the chain is expected to resolve it
expectations.class: the case class; the test prints the rate per class too
expectations.radio_edit / long-short versions: D-010: the canonical identity is at the recording level, and a radio edit is a separate recording. If the duration difference proves this, the match is refused; if the duration is unknown, the chain gives its best guess from the evidence at hand, with fuzzy confidence.
